data.notes: The review gets the header right, says the loss was international only, replaces the average uplift with the customer's own rates (A1), names a person for proof (P2), and uses his words 'approvals' and 'money left on the table'. It misses the new payments leader as the audience, never says the CFO number must be his own by market, gives no per-country answer to local acquiring, leaves out the A1 and A3 line ties, and omits the 9-10 months with no business review.
